freshness.label: SSD / DRAM-HBM HS 明细
freshness.latestReleaseDate: KCS TradeData 官方网页已更新至 2026.04
freshness.nextExpectedDate: 2026年5月最终值预计 2026年6月中旬随 KCS/data.go.kr/TRASS 更新
freshness.note: Chrome 可访问 KCS TradeData 英文 By H.S Code 页面，并通过页面同源查询取得月度出口金额和 KG。SSD 改用 HS 852351（Solid-state non-volatile storage devices），旧 HSK 8471704010 在当前官方查询中无结果；DRAM/HBM 继续用 HS 854232（Memories）。

freshness.label: 半导体月度总量
freshness.nextExpectedDate: 2026-07-01 左右发布 2026年6月月度初值
freshness.note: 5 月半导体出口约 371.6 亿美元，同比 +169.4%；5 月总出口约 877.5 亿美元，同比 +53.2%，MOTIE/KCS 6 月 1 日月度口径。

freshness.label: 存储细分旬度暂估
freshness.nextExpectedDate: 等待 TRASS/KITA 或市场转述公开 2026年5月全月细分数据
freshness.note: 5 月前 20 日细分来自公开券商/市场 Telegram 镜像转述的 Korean customs/TRASS 暂估；KCS TradeData 官方 HWPX 已核验 5 月前 20 日半导体总量，但不拆分 DRAM/SSD/HBM。Memory 总额为 DRAM incl. modules + Flash memory + SSD 的派生值，MCP/HBM proxy 本轮公开源未给单位价。

sourceRegistry.sourceName: KCS TradeData English by H.S Code monthly statistics
sourceRegistry.note: Browser-visible official KCS page provides monthly HS export value in thousand USD and export weight in KG through its same-site query. Verified 2025.01-2026.04 for SSD HS 852351 and DRAM/HBM proxy HS 854232.

Official API source for monthly HS export value and net weight. DATA_GO_KR_SERVICE_KEY was not present in the 2026-05-22 refresh environment; use SSD HS 852351 and DRAM/HBM proxy HS 854232 when configured.

sourceRegistry.sourceName: Korea.kr / MSIT April 2026 ICT export-import trends
sourceRegistry.note: Official public context for April ICT exports, including SSD export value of USD 3.84B and semiconductor/memory market-price commentary; it does not provide HS net weight or USD/kg.

sourceRegistry.sourceName: KCS TradeData press-release list, May 1-20 provisional import/export status
sourceRegistry.note: Official KCS TradeData homepage exposes the May 1-20 provisional release entry dated 2026-05-21. Same-day media reports quoting the KCS release provide semiconductor exports of USD 21,951M, YoY +202.1%; no official public page found with a DRAM/SSD/HBM split.

sourceRegistry.sourceName: TRASS public homepage, provisional trade summary
sourceRegistry.note: Public homepage shows 2026 May 1-20 provisional total exports of USD 52,652M (+64.78%) and imports of USD 41,618M (+29.28%), but product-level provisional lookup is marked premium and was not publicly accessible.

sourceRegistry.sourceName: Korea.kr repost search for May 1-20 KCS provisional release
sourceRegistry.note: Korea.kr search did not expose a repost of the 2026-05-21 KCS May 1-20 provisional release during this refresh.

sourceRegistry.sourceName: MOTIE/KCS May 2026 Export-Import Trends, reported by ChosunBiz
sourceRegistry.note: June 1 monthly release reports May exports of USD 87.75B (+53.2% YoY) and semiconductor exports of USD 37.16B (+169.4% YoY). The dashboard derives the May 21-31 semiconductor tail from this monthly value minus the KCS May 1-20 value.

sourceRegistry.sourceName: KCS June 1-10 2026 provisional export-import status, reported by TaxTimes / Daum
sourceRegistry.note: KCS announced the 2026 June 1-10 provisional trade release on June 11. Public reports give total exports of USD 28.635B (+85.9% YoY), imports of USD 23.352B (+35.6% YoY), trade surplus of USD 5.282B, and semiconductor exports of USD 11.068B (+205.8% YoY, 38.7% share).

sourceRegistry.sourceName: SK Securities Semiconductor Telegram mirror, May 1-20 provisional semiconductor exports
sourceRegistry.note: Public mirror reports May 1-20 DRAM, DRAM module, NAND, MCP, and SSD export values with MoM/QoQ, and states the content is a public release. Used where official KCS source does not disclose product splits.

sourceRegistry.sourceName: Market Telegram mirror of May 1-20 Korean semiconductor export table
sourceRegistry.note: Public mirror reports May 1-20 DRAM incl./excl. modules, flash memory, and SSD export value, YoY, MoM, and USD/kg unit-price changes.
Browser-visible public page showed Korea updated to 2026.04 plus an 854232 export-by-country widget and 2026.04 ICT/IC semiconductor context, but not the monthly net-weight fields needed for USD/kg.

meta.purpose: Taiwan-side AI pull-demand proxy for Korea memory flow plus Japan-to-Taiwan SSD flow.
notes: 韩国→台湾使用台湾财政部开放数据中自韩国进口第16类机械及电机设备，属于AI/HBM链条代理指标，不等同于HS 854232单一存储芯片。
日本→台湾SSD使用日本财务省e-Stat对台湾HS 852351000出口，单位为日元和台数；日本官方出口详细数据最新到2026年3月。

preliminary.sourceName: KCS TradeData May 1-20 provisional release listing
preliminary.trassPublicSourceName: TRASS public homepage, provisional trade summary
preliminary.note: KCS TradeData homepage lists the 2026-05-21 provisional release; TRASS public homepage confirms the overall May 1-20 provisional trade totals. Same-day media reports quoting KCS provide semiconductor exports of USD 21,951M and YoY +202.1%. The publicly visible official listing does not provide a DRAM/SSD/HBM split.

preliminary.sourceName: Derived from May 2026 monthly release minus KCS May 1-20 provisional release
preliminary.note: Tail-window value is derived because the public monthly release gives full-month semiconductor exports and KCS May 1-20 provides the cumulative first-20-day value.

preliminary.sourceName: MOTIE/KCS May 2026 Export-Import Trends, reported by ChosunBiz
preliminary.note: May monthly release: total exports USD 87.75B (+53.2% YoY), semiconductor exports USD 37.16B (+169.4% YoY).

preliminary.sourceName: KCS June 1-10 2026 provisional release, reported by TaxTimes / Daum
preliminary.note: KCS June 1-10 provisional release: total exports USD 28.635B (+85.9% YoY), imports USD 23.352B (+35.6% YoY), trade surplus USD 5.282B, and semiconductor exports USD 11.068B (+205.8% YoY).
